title: Ebook Cover Size: Kindle Cover Dimensions in Pixels (1,600 x 2,560) | Legenddary's SparkPrep
h1: Ebook cover size: the Kindle cover dimensions, in plain English
description: The right ebook cover size for Kindle is 1,600 x 2,560 pixels. Here is the full list of KDP ebook cover rules, how it differs from a print cover, and the mistakes that get covers rejected.
lead: An ebook cover is much simpler than a print cover. It's just the front, as one picture. But it has its own size, and it is not the same as your paperback cover. Here are the numbers.

answer.q: What size should an ebook cover be?
answer.a: For Kindle, Amazon recommends 1,600 pixels wide by 2,560 pixels tall, saved as a JPEG in RGB color. That is a 1 to 1.6 shape. The file must be under 50 MB and no more than 10,000 pixels on a side. It is the front only: no spine, back cover or barcode.

body:
Kindle ebook cover rules at a glance

RuleWhat Amazon KDP says
Best size1,600 x 2,560 pixels (width x height)
ShapeAbout 1 wide to 1.6 tall
Smallest sizeAt least 500 pixels on the long side, or the cover won't show on Amazon. Go much bigger than that.
Biggest size10,000 pixels on each side, 50 MB file
File typeJPEG is best. PNG, TIFF and GIF also work. SVG does not.
ColorRGB (screen color). CMYK is accepted and changed to RGB for you.
What goes on itThe front only, with your title and author name. No spine, back cover or barcode.

From Amazon's Cover Image Guidelines for Kindle eBooks, checked November 2026.

Ebook cover vs print cover

Ebook coverPrint (paperback) cover
What it isThe front onlyBack, spine and front as one piece
Size is set byPixels (1,600 x 2,560)Your trim size, page count and bleed, in inches
BleedNone0.125 inch on every outside edge
ColorRGBCMYK is safest
FileJPEGPrint-ready PDF

Need the print cover too? The book cover size chart lists the exact print cover size for every trim size, and the KDP cover calculator works it out from your page count.

Can I use my paperback front cover as my ebook cover?

Yes, with one change. A 6 x 9 inch paperback front is 1 wide to 1.5 tall. Kindle's best shape is a little taller (1 to 1.6). So either add a bit of background at the top and bottom, or save it at 1,600 x 2,400 pixels. Amazon will still show it. Just cut off the bleed and spine first, so only the front is left.

Mistakes that get ebook covers rejected

  • Too small or blurry. Text that is fuzzy or cut off fails Amazon's check.
  • Words that don't match. The title and author name on the cover must match your book details exactly.
  • Prices or sale words like "only 99 cents" or "free today."
  • Leftover print parts: a spine, back cover or barcode.
  • A white cover with no edge. It disappears on Amazon's white page. Amazon suggests a thin gray border (3 to 4 pixels).

Make the cover once, get every size

SparkPrep, an Automated Publishing Production System (A.P.P.S.), sizes your cover for your book and checks the print version against your printer's rules before you upload. If KDP says your print cover is the wrong size, see how to fix a wrong cover size.

faq.q: What is the best size for a Kindle cover?
faq.a: 1,600 pixels wide by 2,560 pixels tall. Amazon says covers at least 2,500 pixels tall look best on high-definition screens.

faq.q: What DPI should an ebook cover be?
faq.a: Amazon recommends at least 300 DPI. For an ebook, the pixel size (1,600 x 2,560) matters more than the DPI number.

faq.q: Does an ebook cover need bleed?
faq.a: No. Bleed is only for printed covers, because the printer trims the edges. An ebook cover is shown on a screen, so nothing is trimmed.

faq.q: Can my ebook cover be a PNG?
faq.a: Yes. KDP accepts JPEG, PNG, TIFF and non-moving GIF files. JPEG is Amazon's first choice. SVG files are not accepted.
